messages.text: Hello! So, funny story: I ordered these pillow covers thinking they'd match my sofa, and my cat immediately decided one of them was her new bed. Anyway, I sent the pillow cover back, the one that didn't work. Could you refund it? Also, is it normal that colours look different in person?

messages.text:
I found two returned pillow covers on your order: mustard and teal. Which colour would you like refunded? The refund is based on what you paid for the selected unit, excluding shipping (refund-policy/v2/amount).

As for colours looking different in person, our refund policy doesn’t address that.
